question: Identify the correct pair of Indian Dancers who received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards 2021 for their contributions in Bharatanatyam and Kathak, respectively.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jayalakshmi Eshwar and Shama Bhate**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct pair of Indian dancers who received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards 2021 for their contributions in Bharatanatyam and Kathak, respectively, is **Jayalakshmi Eshwar and Shama Bhate**.
 
• **Jayalakshmi Eshwar** (Bharatanatyam):
 
 
• Jayalakshmi Eshwar is a renowned Bharatanatyam dancer who has made significant contributions to the promotion and preservation of this classical dance form.
 
• Bharatanatyam is one of the oldest and most revered classical dance forms of India, originating in Tamil Nadu.
 
 
 
• **Shama Bhate** (Kathak):
 
 
• Shama Bhate is a well-known Kathak dancer and choreographer.
 
• Kathak is a classical dance form originating from the northern part of India, particularly from the courts of North India.
 
• Shama Bhate is recognized for her creative and expressive performances in this art form.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sangeet Natak Akademi

 
 
• Sangeet Natak Akademi, the apex body in the field of performing arts in the country, was formed in 1953.
 
• It was set up for the preservation and promotion of the vast intangible heritage of India's diverse culture expressed in forms of music, dance, and drama.
 
• The management of the Akademi vests in its General Council.
 
• Ariyakudi Ramanuja Iyengar Karaikudi was the first to receive the Sahitya Natak Akademi award.
 
• Sangeet Natak Akademi Puraskar is an award given by the Sangeet Natak Akademi, India's National Academy of Music, Dance & Drama.
 
• The Sangeet Natak Academy was established on 31 May 1952 by a resolution of the Ministry of Human Resource development.
 
• The Akademi was officially inaugurated on 28 January 1953 by the first President of India Rajendra Prasad and PV Rajmannar was appointed as its first Chairman.
